conclusion.historical_pre_match_snapshots: No non-2026/27 season run-level snapshots were found in data/predictions; historical weekly-round tables are outcomes, not authenticated pre-game market captures.
conclusion.temporal_limit: Run timestamps and frozen file hashes establish what was saved in a run and that the run predates the mapped fixture date. They do not alone prove the exact retrieval time of each source; that requires source-side metadata copied into the bundle.
conclusion.future_capture: New prediction runs now copy any adjacent *.meta.json source metadata files into pre_match_snapshot and hash them in manifest.json.
